line.description: 1-based line in the new version of the file.

title.description: The claim alone, at most 120 characters.

body.description: One or two sentences stating the defect.

scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state that lead to wrong output or a crash.

category.description: Short kebab-case slug such as correctness or security.

overall.description: One sentence on the overall state of the change.

item.text: I’ll review the supplied diff for correctness bugs and report them in severity order.

{
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "src/discount.ts",
      "line": 4,
      "end_line": 4,
      "title": "Percentage discounts subtract 100 times the intended amount",
      "body": "The documented percentage input must be divided by 100 before multiplication. Currently, ordinary discounts above 1% produce negative totals for positive inputs.",
      "scenario": "applyDiscount(100, 15) returns -1400 instead of 85.",
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "correctness"
    },
    {
      "file": "src/format.ts",
      "line": 2,
      "end_line": 2,
      "title": "Prices display ten times their actual dollar value",
      "body": "Dividing cents by 10 instead of 100 makes every nonzero price ten times its intended value.",
      "scenario": "formatPrice(100) returns \"$10.00\" instead of \"$1.00\".",
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "correctness"
    }
  ],
  "overall": "Both changed functions contain arithmetic errors that produce incorrect monetary values."
}
